list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are yours, so there is no separate task to chase — work the roadmap in order and it lands last. Keep the checklist open as you play: story first, strangers and collectibles next, then the long grinds. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and see it through to the end — it is the story's first beat and the trophy pops when the mission completes. Take your time learning the controls here; nothing in this mission can be failed permanently. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 to close the chapter and earn this trophy. Story trophies unlock in order, so keep pushing the main missions and check the roadmap to see what comes next. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 by playing its story missions through to the chapter's end. If a mission feels tough, retry it — story progress is never lost. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: See Chapter 3 through to its final mission to earn this trophy. The story opens up here, so enjoy the new ground while the main missions carry you forward. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4's missions to close the chapter. You are deep in the story now — keep the roadmap handy so the side strands do not get left behind. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Play the final mission to its conclusion to earn this gold trophy. Before you start it, clear up any story-tied moments you still want, since the end of the story is the end of the road for one-time beats. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission, so follow the main path until it appears, then see it through. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heists pay to plan: go in with a full stock of supplies and follow the crew's plan. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Follow the story until the mission unlocks, then finish it to earn the trophy. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. This is a story beat, so it arrives as you play the main missions in order. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Expect a hot landing — keep moving and use cover while the takedown plays out. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A big set-piece mission: follow the objectives and the trophy pops at the end. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion by clearing everything the game counts: story missions, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and challenges. This is the last big trophy before the platinum — use the checklist to find what is left. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, air time and two-wheel driving all count toward the total. Chain them during normal driving and the count climbs fast; a fast car and an open highway help. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once, from races and fishing to the shooting range and the arcade. You only need a taste of each, so sample them as you find them across Leonida. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's target pattern, steady your aim, and replay any challenge until gold lands. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Fly clean lines through the gates and brake early for tight turns; a win at each site is all it takes. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida's circuits. Vary the events — the same race twice does not count twice — and pick vehicles suited to each course. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Watch the line tension, reel in when the fish tires, and keep steady pressure to out-fish him. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish. Pick the cabinet that suits you and play it through — a single clear is all it takes. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's mission strand through to its final mission and complete it. Side strands unlock as you meet their characters, so check the map for Andy's marker when it appears. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission and complete it. Follow Kenton's marker when it shows up and finish each job in turn. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's mission strand through to its final mission and complete it. Billy's jobs come one at a time — finish each to unlock the next. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear with map markers as you explore — start their strands early so none gets missed. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's mission strand through to its final mission and complete it. Keep an eye on the map for Randy's marker between story missions. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission and complete it. Tyrone's strand opens when you meet him — finish each job to reach the finale. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. The spots are spread state-wide, so tick them off region by region as you explore. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Track it patiently, mind the wind and your noise, and take the shot when it is clean — there is only one of this animal. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are tucked around Leonida — collect a full set three times over to earn this silver. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Make it a habit at every new spot you visit and the count will climb as you cross the state. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more — work through the list and the total builds steadily. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level while out with your partner, then escape the heat. Build the wanted level, break line of sight, and lay low in cover until the stars clear. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row and keep the heat on — do not let the stars drop between robberies. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you get into counts, so hop into anything unfamiliar as you travel. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a tight group, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it ends. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave the airport in a way the schedule never planned. Pick your moment, move fast, and get airborne or out of the gate on your own terms. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks are the hottest hardware on the road, so bring heavy weapons and keep your distance. The trophy's own description is a hint: things get hot in a Rhino. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go quiet: avoid cameras and sightlines, move slowly, and leave before anyone knows you were there. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Plan each hit, crack the vault, and get clear before the law closes in — five clean escapes earn the silver. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop the truck, take the cash, and break away before backup arrives. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, fly and walk the whole map until every area is uncovered — the count fills in as you go. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find one operation per gang, hit it, and move on — nine gangs, nine hits. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the beachfront, order a drink, and take in the view — a quiet moment that counts. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Take a car through the glass in true GTA fashion and make your getaway. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a game at the alley and see it through to the end. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — the description points to a story beat shared with your partner. Play the story and let the moment arrive; it comes with the partnership. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — the game tracks your decisions, with a count running to 500. Keep deciding: every choice counts, so play on and let the total build. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — succeed where you once failed. If a moment beats you the first time, go back and take it on the second try. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description asks what just happened, so keep your eyes open for the odd and unexplained across Leonida. It finds you when you least expect it. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock someone down — timing and speed do the work. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Move the bills through your laundering contacts steadily — the total adds up over time. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy gear, clothes, food and upgrades as you play and the total climbs on its own. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy garages as your cash allows — each one is a home for your growing collection. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Add vehicles to the app one by one until ten are on the books. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
